_note: Pictures chosen by hand for the notable entities (cloud session, 2026-11-01): entity id -> Commons file, preferred over the Wikidata P18 candidate. Chosen from the entities' Commons categories; preference for the 19th/early-20th-century Edda illustrators (Frølich 1895, Gehrts, Doepler, Collingwood 1908, Dollman, Hardy, Engels, Heine, E. B. Smith, John Bauer) and the 17th–18th-century Icelandic manuscript drawings (SÁM 66, NKS 1867 4to, AM 738 4to). The pipeline still confirms every licence through the Commons API (images.json) and uses a picture only when it passes. Note for the record: Willy Pogány (d. 1955) and Franz Stassen (d. 1949) are public domain in the UK/EU only since 2026 / 2020. reject: candidates never to use (postage stamps are usually not free). Where a picture shows a scene, the alt text names the scene, not just the entity.
